services.name: Charter Info
services.desc: The skipper aboard, Captain Sam Zucco, has been fishing the waters of Lake Ontario since 1978. His experience and knowledge of the fishery are sure to provide you with a great and safe day of fishing. The DREAM CATCHER, 33′ Trojan made boat. Her wide 13.3-foot beam makes for a comfortable and stable fishing platform for you to fish on. Room for 8 people with plenty of room to spare. This famous fishery of Lake Ontario boats the largest salmon to be had of ANY of the great lakes. Trophy salmon, rainbow trout, brown trout & lake trout are common - Lake Ontario is a world class fishery!
